title: Captain Chris' Fishing Charters
specs: Fish on a 25-foot Skip jack boat with a comfortable cabin and restroom

blurb: Captain Chris offers private fishing charters on a 25-foot Skip jack boat with a cabin and restroom. Trips primarily target Mackinaw trout, with rainbow trout fishing from July through September after catching Mackinaw. Charters last approximately 4 hours and depart early morning from April through September; winter trips depend on wind and weather.
extraNote: Winter trips are wind and weather permitting · Tahoe City Marina, Tahoe City, North Lake Tahoe California · April through September; winter trips wind and weather permitting
